question: 39. Two integers $m$ and $n$ are called relatively prime if the greatest common divisor of $m$ and $n$ is 1. Prove that among any five consecutive positive integers there is one integer which is relatively prime to the other four integers. (Hint: For any two positive integers $m<n$, any common divisor has to be less than or equal to $n-m$.)

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
